title: allmeta — open browser-only tools for evidence synthesis
description: allmeta is a browser-only catalog of evidence-synthesis tools spanning pairwise and network meta-analysis, diagnostic test accuracy, dose-response modelling, risk-of-bias assessment, GRADE, PRISMA, trial sequential analysis, individual participant data analysis, and clinical decision support. Each app is a self-contained HTML+JS+CSS bundle that runs offline; computation happens client-side and no data is uploaded. Many numerical engines are cross-checked against canonical R packages (metafor, meta, netmeta, mada). A shared ma-studies-v1 / ma-comparisons-v1 data bus carries study- and arm-level data between apps, and selected apps emit HMAC-signed TruthCert receipts so reviewers can verify that the inputs and outputs on a result page match the analysis that produced them.
